message: Last winter, we had a surprise snowstorm. I had just settled in with a cup of tea and a good book when I realized I had no bread for toast—my emergency snack of choice. So there I was, in a flurry of snow and confusion, making a mental list of all the things I should have stocked up on. Turns out, a few extra supplies go a long way in keeping the comedy of not being ready at bay. What’s your go-to emergency snack? 🥨
